datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2013 and spatially referenced to administrative units in Chad. The classifications represent assessments of acute food insecurity phases across different scenarios, aggregated into geographic features for monitoring food security crises.
